programmes.d: An in-depth look at the journalists who exposed the dangers of cult leader Reverend Jim Jones; interviews with witnesses to murders carried out by Jones' followers.
An aspiring Playboy model is brutally murdered in Miami after visiting a nightclub with her boyfriend.
Two decades after a woman falls to her death, police reopen the case and arrest her husband.
A mother, who seemed to be happily married, was found dead in her backyard spa.

After New Jersey mother Michelle Lodzinski reports that her 5-year-old son has vanished from a carnival, detectives embark on a decadeslong investigation until a family member identifies a key piece of evidence pointing to a potential suspect.
The investigation into the death of Spokane, Wash., businessman exposes a web of malevolence extending from the Pacific Northwest to a North Dakota oil field.
After finding his wife and two children dead, a former Indiana state trooper spends 13 years trying to clear his name.
When a man claims to have found his wife dead in the bathtub, the woman's daughters suspect there may be more to the story.
A woman's DNA test sends her father halfway around the world to confront his past.
A car belonging to a missing man erupts in a blaze, leading to clues regarding his whereabouts.
After disappearing for a decade with a convict, officials question the deputy warden's wife's role in his escape.
A young art student from Texas is found murdered in her bed with no sign of forced entry, indicating that she knew her killer.
The murder of former NBA star and hometown hero Lorenzen Wright sends shockwaves through the city of Memphis; insiders speak out about new developments in the lengthy search for justice.
When Dr. Teresa Sievers is found murdered in her kitchen, detectives struggle to find any leads until an unexpected tip changes everything; the woman who helped investigators speaks out.
After a young Army veteran disappears, detectives uncover a cryptic 911 call placed 11 days before she went missing, which exposes a twisted story -- and the truth.
Two tenacious sisters determined to fulfill a promise investigate the mystery surrounding their mother's death.
Key players in the case of Rod Covlin, a New York man who is found guilty of murdering his wife for her $5.3 million fortune and attempting to frame his then-teenage daughter, share their stories.
Police investigate whether the murder of a South Florida attorney is connected to a web of fraud, betrayal and more than $1 billion in missing money.
A chance encounter on the Pacific Coast Highway with a woman he first spoke to in a jail cell leads Keith Morrison to reexamine the mysterious death of Las Vegas casino magnate Ted Binion.
A bombshell more than a decade after the crime reignites the investigation into the death of Sarah Pagel's mother, who was killed when Sarah was seven.
A Connecticut bank executive is targeted by criminals who force him to rob his own bank.

A beloved Staten Island teacher is found dead in the home she shared with her husband; an unknown number in her cell phone leads investigators to reveal troubles in her seemingly idyllic life -- and to ultimately unearth her killer.
